name: Coronation Recreation Ground
summary: This Hersham park combines a children's play area, outdoor sport (bowls, cricket, football, tennis, netball) and a measured one-mile route. Coffee in the Park serves the car park, and the Elmbridge Community Eco Hub adds community and environmental initiatives on site.
reasonToVisit: A large Hersham park with play, sport, a café and an environmental community hub
planningDetail: Free car park off Molesey Road opposite Molesey Close; principal routes are practical for wheelchairs and buggies
